reviews.title: Class‑Action Cash
reviews.text:
Payout makes managing class‑actions much easier, and in a way that truly feels supportive. Instead of sorting through endless emails or worrying about missing out on money, everything is organized and easy to understand.

I appreciate how the app explains what the claim is for, what I qualify for, and what I need to do next. There’s no confusing language, just straightforward updates. 

Filing a claim becomes simple, almost like ticking off a small task. The app is efficient and surprisingly satisfying. If you’re looking for an app that keeps you informed and saves you time, payout makes the process easier and pleasant to use.

reviews.title: Scam/ Fraud please Don’t waste your money
reviews.text: I had a terrible experience with the Payout app. They advertise themselves as a platform for settlement claim class action or lawsuit payouts, but it’s nothing but a scam. After providing my information, I received no legitimate offers or payouts. Instead, I encountered misleading information and frustrating delays. I’ve tried to contact them but no response,It’s clear that this app is designed to take advantage of users. I will do my best to pursue proper legal action to hold them accountable for their fraudulent behavior. I strongly advise staying away and not wasting your time, money or personal information on this app.

reviews.title: Scam, DO NOT USE
reviews.text:
I accidentally subscribed while trying to exit the app and delete it because it wasn’t what I was looking for. Within just a few minutes—literally as soon as I found where to contact support—I requested a cancellation and refund. Despite the immediate request, I was denied a refund due to “unmet criteria.”

This feels like a payout scam disguised as a subscription app. The customer service was unhelpful, inflexible, and showed zero willingness to resolve an honest mistake. Unfortunately, it looks like I’ve thrown away money on an app I never even used.

I don’t recommend this app. Be cautious before downloading

reviews.title: Scam don’t buy
reviews.text: I originally saw this app as an ad on TikTok and it seemed pretty convincing, so I was curious enough to buy the annual pass. However, a month after submitting my claims, the app disappeared and came back with another name called “Payout”. This logged me out before I was ever able to claim the money from my settlements. I am able to log in through the website they have but theres no option to claim my money. It says ive cashed out when that is not true. Also the support team does not get back to you in a timely manner, just a scam and waste of money just disappointed …

reviews.title: Misleading — Half the Opportunities Are Already Closed
reviews.text:
Tried this app on a free trial. At first it looks like a goldmine  long list of settlement “opportunities.” But once you get past the paywall, you realize a bunch of them are already CLOSED. That’s something they should disclose up front, not after you’ve paid.

It’s like paying to get into a buffet and then finding out there are no more trays left. If you’re gonna charge people a monthly fee, at least be transparent about what’s actually open vs. what’s expired. Otherwise, you’re just selling leftovers.

Be careful before spending your money here.

reviews.title: “payout pro” more like “pay them” pro..
reviews.text:
This app just wants your money. I did more research on this app after seeing a promotion and this app is still so new. as of now the 5 star reviews “claiming” they earned their money are a bit suspicious because class action settlement money takes a while? how did they “already” get paid out? 

Very suspicious. I would recommend you all just to file on websites for FREE instead of this “convenience” they offer but is all inaccurate

reviews.title: 0 stars. Scam.
reviews.text: Please do not buy the subscription as they do not give refunds even a minute after they take your money if you may decide to cancel the subscription for any reason. I accidentally subscribed to this app (didn’t notice it wasn’t the app I was actually trying to subscribe to..) right away I emailed the support app and they didn’t answer at first so after about two weeks I emailed them again and they said they could not give me a refund. It is a scam.

reviews.title: Warning -Hidden fees and costs not disclosed until after purchase.
reviews.text: After purchasing the app when I tried to use it I was then informed about several ridiculously high fees and legal costs. You would lucky to have $1 left out of a $5000 settlement with all their costs. Their cut is 40% off the top which is beyond ridiculous and then they give a whole list of other fees and costs. You might win a settlement but Payout and the lawyers get all the money.

reviews.title: Save your time and skip this one
reviews.text: what a complete scam. this company should be ashamed because they just want your money. I know what class action settlements are, i have been filing them for a while. i saw this pop up and i did the beginning section when u start and they want all your information and then ask you to PAY THEM. first of all filing is usually free 100% i have filed in the past. It’s ridiculous. please save ur time.

reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text: This app is a scam. It has links to class action settlements however you cannot file them unless you received an email about the settlement yourself with login information. If you have that there is no need for the app. They mislead you into paying for their app. Again you do not file anything in the app, it is a scam with bot reviews. Google class action suits and get the same results for free. Don’t get scammed!
